record.tranche_reason: The README describes the repository as a replication of the original study, and the file list includes generated direction, ablation, activation-addition, refusal-evaluation, and capability-evaluation result files. The actual result contents are unavailable here.
record.gate_note: The README describes a pipeline for generating directions, evaluating ablation and activation addition, and checking harmless-data loss and general-language benchmarks. The file list includes result files for these evaluations, but the README reports no outcome values or explicit findings. Per the repo rules, no rows can be extracted from filenames alone.
record.test_reason: A replication repository of the original paper using the same pipeline (difference-in-means candidate directions, ablation, activation addition, refusal and Llama Guard scoring, CE loss, coherence) on the original model families. It bears on V1 by design, but only the README and a truncated file list are available, and no outcome values are stated, so no verdict can be drawn.
record.authors_conclusion: Correct. The README presents the repo as a replication mostly following the original code but built on NNsight. It notes its own coherence-evaluation implementation and some accuracy differences from the paper, and states no conclusion on refusal outcomes.
record.recipe_differences: The README says the code mostly follows the original codebase, with modifications to use NNsight. This is a replication repository; its README does not state result values.

fits_no_version.finding: An added evaluation of whether the scalar projection onto the refusal vector tracks the degree of refusal, on harmful/harmless test splits and XSTest (magnitude_corr.json). No values are given in the text.
fits_no_version.proposed_claim: The magnitude of the projection onto the refusal direction tracks the graded degree of refusal, including exaggerated refusal on XSTest safe prompts.
